the distributed atoms algorithm is the most efficient for atom mapping, that the MasPar MP1104 is the most efficient array processor for atom mapping, and that the Connection Machine CM- 200 is not an effective machine for this application.

atom mapping is a good algorithm for performing approximate graph matching in three-dimensional chemical databases; that it can be effectively implemented on massively-parallel array processors; that the MasPar MP is the fastest of the array processors studied; and that the MasPar machine is the best choice for performing atom mapping searches in large files of three-dimensional structures.
atom mapping can be effectively implemented on massively parallel array processors and that the MasPar MP series is currently the most efficient platform for this application.

the use of massively-parallel array processors in the implementation of similarity searching in databases containing three-dimensional chemical structures.
the development and implementation of algorithms and software for similarity searching in files of chemical structures.
the development and evaluation of massively-parallel algorithms for the efficient similarity searching of three-dimensional chemical structure databases.

atom mapping is a computationally demanding task that can be performed efficiently by massively parallel computers.

atom mapping can be implemented on a massively- parallel array processor to give search times that are at least two orders of magnitude faster than the best times reported for a serial processor.
